t: Ready-to-use, vacuum-packed, 1-component patio jointing mortar. Ready-mixed and ideal for DIY use. Resistant to frost and de-icing salts. Suitable for coated and sensitive stone surfaces, ceramic slabs, almost all natural stones, natural and concrete stone slabs and clinker stone surfaces. Also for use on patios, footpaths and surfaces which have occasional light vehicle loads. Firm to walk on and no weed growth.
